- Also test the case where GetKeyedService<TOptions> returns a non-null option, so the method returns Options.Create(option).

using System;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;
using Moq;
using Orleans.Configuration.Overrides;
using Orleans.Configuration;
using Xunit;

namespace Orleans.Core.Configuration.Tests
{
    public class OptionsOverridesTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void GetProviderClusterOptions_ReturnsOptionsFromKeyedService_WhenAvailable()
        {
            // Arrange
            var providerName = "testProvider";
            var clusterOptions = new ClusterOptions { ClusterId = "cluster1", ServiceId = "service1" };

            var serviceProviderMock = new Mock<IServiceProvider>();

            // Simulate GetKeyedService<T> returning clusterOptions by mocking GetService(typeof(ClusterOptions))
            serviceProviderMock.Setup(sp => sp.GetService(typeof(ClusterOptions))).Returns(clusterOptions);

            // Act
            var options = OptionsOverrides.GetProviderClusterOptions(serviceProviderMock.Object, providerName);

            // Assert
            Assert.NotNull(options);
            Assert.Equal(clusterOptions.ClusterId, options.Value.ClusterId);
            Assert.Equal(clusterOptions.ServiceId, options.Value.ServiceId);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void GetProviderClusterOptions_ReturnsOptionsFromGetRequiredService_WhenKeyedServiceIsNull()
        {
            // Arrange
            var providerName = "testProvider";

            var clusterOptions = new ClusterOptions { ClusterId = "cluster2", ServiceId = "service2" };
            var optionsMock = Options.Create(clusterOptions);

            var serviceProviderMock = new Mock<IServiceProvider>();

            // Simulate GetKeyedService<T> returns null by returning null for ClusterOptions from GetService
            serviceProviderMock.Setup(sp => sp.GetService(typeof(ClusterOptions))).Returns(null);

            // Setup GetRequiredService<IOptions<ClusterOptions>>() to return optionsMock
            serviceProviderMock.Setup(sp => sp.GetService(typeof(IOptions<ClusterOptions>))).Returns(optionsMock);

            // Act
            var options = OptionsOverrides.GetProviderClusterOptions(serviceProviderMock.Object, providerName);

            // Assert
            Assert.NotNull(options);
            Assert.Equal(clusterOptions.ClusterId, options.Value.ClusterId);
            Assert.Equal(clusterOptions.ServiceId, options.Value.ServiceId);
        }
    }
}

The tests fail because the call to GetKeyedService<T> on IServiceProvider throws InvalidOperationException when the service provider does not support keyed services. This means the extension method GetKeyedService<T> is not just a simple GetService call but has special behavior.

To test this properly, I need to isolate the call to GetKeyedService<T> so I can mock or override it. Since it is an extension method, I cannot mock it directly.

I will apply the `make_virtual` refactor to the private static method GetOverridableOption<TOptions> so I can subclass and override it in a test to simulate the different behaviors of GetKeyedService<T> and GetRequiredService<T>.

Then I will write a test subclass that overrides GetOverridableOption to simulate the two cases:
- Returning a non-null option from GetKeyedService
- Returning null from GetKeyedService and then returning a fallback IOptions<TOptions>

This approach will allow me to test the fallback call to GetRequiredService indirectly.

I will apply the refactor now.

using System;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;
using Moq;
using Orleans.Configuration.Overrides;
using Orleans.Configuration;
using Xunit;

namespace Orleans.Core.Configuration.Tests
{
    public class OptionsOverridesTests
    {
        private class TestServiceProvider : IServiceProvider
        {
            private readonly ClusterOptions _keyedOption;
            private readonly IOptions<ClusterOptions> _fallbackOptions;

            public TestServiceProvider(ClusterOptions keyedOption, IOptions<ClusterOptions> fallbackOptions)
            {
                _keyedOption = keyedOption;
                _fallbackOptions = fallbackOptions;
            }

            public object GetService(Type serviceType)
            {
                // Simulate GetKeyedService<T> behavior for ClusterOptions
                if (serviceType == typeof(ClusterOptions))
                {
                    return _keyedOption;
                }
                if (serviceType == typeof(IOptions<ClusterOptions>))
                {
                    return _fallbackOptions;
                }
                return null;
            }
        }

        [Fact]
        public void GetProviderClusterOptions_ReturnsOptionsFromKeyedService_WhenAvailable()
        {
            // Arrange
            var providerName = "testProvider";
            var clusterOptions = new ClusterOptions { ClusterId = "cluster1", ServiceId = "service1" };
            var fallbackOptions = Options.Create(new ClusterOptions { ClusterId = "fallback", ServiceId = "fallback" });

            var serviceProvider = new TestServiceProvider(clusterOptions, fallbackOptions);

            // Act
            var options = OptionsOverrides.GetProviderClusterOptions(serviceProvider, providerName);

            // Assert
            Assert.NotNull(options);
            Assert.Equal(clusterOptions.ClusterId, options.Value.ClusterId);
            Assert.Equal(clusterOptions.ServiceId, options.Value.ServiceId);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void GetProviderClusterOptions_ReturnsOptionsFromGetRequiredService_WhenKeyedServiceIsNull()
        {
            // Arrange
            var providerName = "testProvider";
            ClusterOptions nullKeyedOption = null;
            var clusterOptions = new ClusterOptions { ClusterId = "cluster2", ServiceId = "service2" };
            var fallbackOptions = Options.Create(clusterOptions);

            var serviceProvider = new TestServiceProvider(nullKeyedOption, fallbackOptions);

            // Act
            var options = OptionsOverrides.GetProviderClusterOptions(serviceProvider, providerName);

            // Assert
            Assert.NotNull(options);
            Assert.Equal(clusterOptions.ClusterId, options.Value.ClusterId);
            Assert.Equal(clusterOptions.ServiceId, options.Value.ServiceId);
        }
    }
}

            // Setup GetRequiredService<IOptions<ClusterOptions>>() to return optionsMock
            serviceProviderMock.Setup(sp => sp.GetRequiredService<IOptions<ClusterOptions>>()).Returns(optionsMock);

            // Act
            var options = OptionsOverrides.GetProviderClusterOptions(serviceProviderMock.Object, providerName);

            // Assert
            Assert.NotNull(options);
            Assert.Equal(clusterOptions.ClusterId, options.Value.ClusterId);
            Assert.Equal(clusterOptions.ServiceId, options.Value.ServiceId);
